build_dataset_tfrecord: build a tf.data.Dataset from TFRecord files with feature scaling and shuffling for Neural LNS training
create_graphs_tuple: create a GraphsTuple from a branch-and-bound node state dictionary with padded variable and constraint features
extract_data_mip: extract a DatasetTuple from a MIP state dictionary with optional feature scaling and binary variable labels
decode_tfrecord_example: decode a serialized TFRecord example into a parsed dictionary of tensors for Neural LNS dataset loading
apply_feature_scaling: apply feature scaling to MIP state and labels by normalizing continuous variable bounds and solutions
